comparison.objective: Pack fifteen pool balls tightly in a triangle and remove the rack without disturbing them.
comparison.physical_skill: Many-body compaction, frame manipulation, and disturbance-free release.
comparison.success_condition: All required ball pairs tightly packed, head ball on the spot, rack clear, balls still, and no excessive motion during rack removal.
comparison.reason: Both involve a manipulated frame and many loose bodies, but this tests compaction and frame removal while preserving every body; the candidate tests aperture-mediated passage of one class while retaining another.
